engines.name: llama.cpp / Metal
engines.notes: Metal is documented for Apple Silicon. The specific M5 Max/macOS/build/model combination requires a LAB30 smoke test; 6 GiB is a hypothesis. For comparison with Ryzen, pin one commit and identical GGUF hashes.

engines.name: MLX-LM / Metal
engines.notes: Separate MLX weights, quantization config, tokenizer/template, and mlx/mlx-lm versions; GGUF sizes do not apply. Architecture, tool parser, peak memory, and M5 Max require LAB31–32.

engines.name: Ollama / Metal (GGUF)
engines.notes: Profile for importing the exact GGUF without requantization. Confirm the blob hash and actual selected runner/Metal; do not treat all Ollama versions as one engine. A different format or MLX runner is a separate condition; this profile does not apply to it.

engines.name: LM Studio / llama.cpp Metal
engines.notes: Pin the application and separate runtime package/version; import the same GGUF. Device/offload and M5 Max remain unverified until LAB33; GUI version does not determine the llama.cpp commit.

engines.name: LM Studio / MLX
engines.notes: Separate MLX runtime with its own artifact manifest; do not transfer GGUF sizes/quantization. For overhead comparisons, confirm that weights and the internal runtime match the direct track; otherwise compare deployments.
